invariants_checked: I1 reset returns exactly the pristine state from any state: native machine::reset_uarch (writes halt/pc/cycle/x1..x31, rewrites uarch RAM image and zero-fills the tail, x0 is read-only everywhere: write_reg refuses uarch_x0, init refuses a nonzero uarch x0, uarch writeX skips rd=0), uarch_record_state_access::do_reset_uarch (whole 2^22 node, self-verified), uarch_replay_state_access::do_reset_uarch and Solidity EmulatorCompat.resetState (write UARCH_PRISTINE_STATE_HASH over the 2^22 node), collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes' dirty-word reset (requires a pristine node at entry, restores m_us->registers and every dirtied RAM word, handles the word straddling the image end). Experiment exp2: all 31 uarch x registers, halt, cycle, pc and all 2 MiB of uarch RAM set to garbage, then reset_uarch -> uarch node hash equals get_uarch_pristine_hash(); writes into the 0x401000-0x600000 gap and into the shadow-uarch page tail are refused natively.

I2 a step when halted or at/after the cycle limit is the identity on every path, and halt takes precedence over overflow: uarch-step.cpp reads cycle then halt and returns without writes; regenerated UArchStep.sol identical in control flow and access order; uarch_interpret identical. Experiment exp1 (baremetal-minimal, regenerated StepVerifier on the shared anvil via eth_call): cycle=MAX not halted, cycle=MAX with halt=5, cycle=2^64-1, cycle=MAX-1 ordinary insn, cycle=MAX-1 halt ECALL, cycle=MAX-1 putchar ECALL: native after-hash == C++ verify_step_uarch == EVM step, and EVM stepThenReset == native log_step_uarch+log_reset_uarch after-hash in every case; statuses as expected (halted reported over overflow).

I3 every ECALL argument the pristine program can produce is accepted identically by native, replay and Solidity: halt (any a0..a6), putchar (any a0; native forwards to the console and ignores the flush flag, replay/record/collect/Solidity are no-ops), write_tlb with set 0,1,2, slot 255, vaddr_page 0xdeadbeefcafe1000, vp_offset 2^64-1, pma_index 2^64-1: native/replay/EVM agree (exp1). Set 3 and function 3 are refused natively, by replay and by Solidity (revert). The pristine program only issues fn 1,2,4 with set in {0,1,2} and slot < 256 (uarch-bridge-state-access.hpp, interpret.cpp flush_tlb_slot/replace_tlb_entry).

I4 the uarch cycle count of an mcycle is a function of the main state alone: the uarch RAM (code, .data sentinel, .bss/.sbss guard variables, the static mock_address_ranges cache, the stack) is pristine at each mcycle start on every path; the uarch reads the main state only through readWord of shadow registers, PMA table words, shadow TLB words and guest memory, all hashed; no uninitialised host data (stack and .bss start zeroed by the reset).

I5 no uarch-visible value comes from outside the hashed state: native uarch_state_access reads words through machine::read_word -> read_memory (host contents of hashed ranges; the penumbra/hot TLB is outside the shadow state length); the bridge's do_init_hot_tlb_slot returns the shadow vaddr_page and verify_cold_tlb_slot re-verifies it against the hashed PMA entry, as native init_hot_tlb_slot does; getchar returns -1 in the uarch (the native divergence after write_reg(iconsole) is R3-VARSHADOW-1); soft_yield only breaks the native loop.

I6 the PMA table seen by the uarch mock ranges: on the valid template every PMA entry is either M (memory, flash, cmio buffers, DTB, PMA array) or CLINT/HTIF/PLIC, so a guest access to a hole (which walks every entry until the zero-length sentinel) constructs only handled mock ranges; index >= PMA_MAX returns the same empty sentinel natively and in the uarch.

I7 uarch program image: ELF sections (one LOAD segment, .bss/.sbss NOBITS at the end, .data sentinel before .bss), image length 0x99a10 (not a multiple of 32: the straddling word is handled by every reset path), memsz 0x9a328 far below the 2 MiB stack top; the strings in the image show the asserts compiled in (soft-float normalize/normalize2 shift >= 0, assert_no_brk, get_highest_priority_irq_num, interpret's final mcycle assert, mock range aborts, device read/write_memory aborts that are only reachable through virtual methods no compiled device calls).
not_covered: Exhaustive differential fuzzing of uarch-step.cpp vs the regenerated UArchStep.sol over random uarch instructions and register values (only the ECALL/halt/cycle-limit cases above were run on the EVM; instruction semantics rely on the 56 replay tests).

The soft-float normalize/normalize2 asserts (enabled only in the uarch build, NDEBUG natively) were not fuzzed; they come from SoftFP, where the invariant holds by construction, and earlier rounds reasoned them unreachable.

assert_no_brk in the uarch at every reachable state (pending interrupts after instructions returning plain success in S/U mode): only re-read CLINT write paths (all return success_and_serve_interrupts when they set a pending bit); PLIC/HTIF and CSR writers were not re-enumerated.

Compiler-dependent semantics between the native (x86-64, gnu++23, -O2, NDEBUG for interpret.cpp) and uarch (rv64i, -O2, asserts on) builds of interpret.cpp: no UB scan beyond shifts, clz guards and signed-overflow flags (-fno-strict-overflow in both).
Worst-case uarch cycles per mcycle combining an interrupt, a trap and two TLB flushes in one mcycle (reasoned to stay near 40k, far below 2^20-1; not measured).

The released (non-regenerated) step v0.17.0-test1 and the access-order change of 4310fa3 (step at the cycle limit now reads halt) across versions; CM_MARCHID bump coverage of that change (R13/A6 angle, R1-A6-2 family).
Uarch behaviour under sha256 machines, unreproducible machines, CODE_COVERAGE/ZKARCHITECTURE/DUMP_* builds, and the coverage pristine pair (uarch-pristine-*-coverage.c).
Stored/loaded machines carrying a non-pristine uarch shadow page tail or uarch RAM (R1-R4-1 family, snapshot-trust exclusions) were not re-examined.
Gas cost of uarch step/reset proofs on the EVM (only correctness via eth_call).
